# Oud Metha Building 298

> This mid-rise building occupies a plot in Oud Metha, a central Dubai district bordered by Al Karama, Umm Hurair and Zabeel and served by the Green Line metro. It has two basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine, eleven upper storeys and a roof level, giving thirteen levels above ground. Its scale is typical of the mixed commercial and residential blocks that line Oud Metha's main roads.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Oud Metha, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This mid-rise building stands on a plot in Oud Metha, one of Dubai's established central districts. It comprises two basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine, eleven upper floors and a roof level. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building for Transemirates, delivering the building services across all levels.
